$comment: Documented, EXPIRING exceptions for `npm run audit:ci` (the CI supply-chain gate, tasks.md 6.3/6.4). Every entry needs a reason, an advisory URL, and an `expires` date; once expired it no longer suppresses the advisory, so the gate re-blocks and forces a fresh review. Any high/critical advisory NOT listed here still blocks. Keep this list short and each entry justified. Currently EMPTY: the two exceptions it once held (react-router GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2, brace-expansion GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg) were retired by upgrading to react-router 8 and ESLint 10 rather than renewed.
